scheme_name: Grant of Fuel Subsidy to Differently Abled Persons Who Are Owning Motorised Vehicles
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native/resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years
Vehicle must be registered in the applicant's name
Distance between the applicant's residence and the duty point must be greater than 6 km
Disability percentage must be 40% or higher
Applicant must not be receiving any transport allowance from the Department or any other source
benefits_summary: Up to 50% subsidy on fuel cost, capped at 15 litres for vehicles under 2 HP and 25 litres for vehicles of 2 HP or more
